notes: This was the most heavily corrected episode so far. Rule B found 8 errors: two literal typos in the data ('Goncjarz'->'Gonciarz', appearing twice) and six mentions timestamped one caption-line too early/late (including 'Bestii z Tokio', which was actually split across two lines and is now marked as a multi-line mention). Rule C then flagged ~50 further misses, the great majority inflected/typo forms of 'Daria Dąbrowska', 'Krzysztof Gonciarz', 'Katarzyna Meciński', and 'Hanna Koczewska'. One important false-positive source needed manual disambiguation: the entity 'V' (alias 'W') is genuinely referred to throughout this episode using several short spoken-letter variants ('V', 'W', 'Vi', 'Wi') -- but the 2-character target 'Wi' also coincidentally appears as a substring inside many ordinary Polish words (Więc/Wiecie/Większość/Wiadomo/Widzicie/Wiedziałbym/Wiesz), so each occurrence was checked individually in context; the genuine 'V'/'Wi' mentions were kept and the ~14 coincidental substring matches inside ordinary words were confirmed as noise and left unmarked (see residual Rule C warnings below). A full manual read-through of the transcript then surfaced roughly 15 further real mentions Rule C could not catch on its own (inflected/typo forms not already present elsewhere as a known target), including a correctly-identified 'Chris' used as a real direct address in a quoted English email (distinct from the 'Jesus Christ' idiom false-positive pattern seen in other episodes), a second distinct 'Maja' (Maja Mikołajczyk, separate from the much more frequently discussed Maja Staśko), and several multi-line surname splits ('Sylwestra'/'Wardengi', 'Weronikę'/'Truszczyńską', 'Hannie'/'Zegulskiej'). One occurrence was deliberately excluded, consistent with earlier episodes: 'Maciek' at [01:03:40] -- 'mój biały kolega nazwijmy go Maciek' ('my white friend, let's call him Maciek') is an explicit anonymizing placeholder, not a reference to the entity 'Maciej' (id 78). The 14 residual 'Wi' Rule C warnings and the 'Maciek' warning are expected and intentionally left unmarked. Update: the entity "Nazwijmy go Maciek" (id 124) was subsequently added to the master entity list to formally track this recurring anonymizing-placeholder character; the previously-excluded 'Maciek' mention at [01:03:40] is now included, tagged to id 124 instead of being dropped.
